# MM-P1-L2-HT03 Maintenance manual - Ring Rolling heat treat furnace #3

Revision: Rev E  
Plant: P1, line P1-L2  
Equipment: EQ-P1-L2-HT03

Scope
- This manual defines preventive maintenance and verification tasks for Ring Rolling heat treat furnace #3 (EQ-P1-L2-HT03).  
- Activities covered include visual inspection, control system verification, thermocouple verification, atmosphere and door seal checks, and record keeping required to support process control for ring rolling heat treat operations.  
- This document is intended for maintenance technicians and process engineers assigned to P1-L2 and references operational procedures for normal use and safety. See SOP-P1-L2-01, SOP-P1-L2-04, and SOP-P1-L2-05 for related operational and safety controls.

Background and rationale
- Furnace condition and sensor accuracy directly affect metallurgical outcomes for ring rolling operations. The defined steps aim to provide a repeatable approach to preserve equipment integrity and traceability of actions.  
- Critical control point: austenitizing temperature. Maintaining the setpoint and verifying sensor integrity reduces rework and scrap risk. The austenitizing setpoint for Ring Rolling heat treat furnace #3 (EQ-P1-L2-HT03) is 855 °C.  
- Sensor drift is a common failure mode. The thermocouple calibration interval for Ring Rolling heat treat furnace #3 (EQ-P1-L2-HT03) is 95 days. Adhering to this interval supports consistent process control and audit readiness.

Tools
- Hand tools appropriate for electrical and mechanical access as defined in SOP-P1-L2-01.  
- Portable reference thermometer or temperature calibration bath and reference thermocouple traceable to the laboratory standard.  
- Sealant inspection mirror and flashlight.  
- Electrical safety test instrument as specified in SOP-P1-L2-04.  
- Logbook or electronic maintenance record access device and calibrated tags as described in SOP-P1-L2-05.

Procedure
- Pre-checks and safety
  - Confirm furnace is in safe state for maintenance according to SOP-P1-L2-01. Lockout-tagout per plant practice before any mechanical or electrical work begins. Consult SOP-P1-L2-04 for electrical isolation verification.  
  - Review last maintenance record and thermocouple calibration entry in the maintenance log.

- Visual and mechanical inspection
  - Inspect door seals for continuity and integrity. Look for gaps, distortion, or worn material that could allow atmosphere purge loss. Document findings in the maintenance log with a brief description and action taken.  
  - Inspect furnace interior lining for spalling or deformation. Photograph any anomalies and attach images to the maintenance record. Note condition and expected repair plan per SOP-P1-L2-05.

- Control system verification
  - With the furnace in a safe mode, verify operator interface communicates with the controller. Exercise basic control commands as allowed by SOP-P1-L2-01. Record any alarm conditions and reference error codes to the control vendor documentation.  
  - Confirm alarm setpoints and interlocks are present and functioning. Update records with date, technician initials, and any changes.

- Thermocouple verification and calibration
  - Remove thermocouple covers and inspect leads for mechanical damage, oxidation, and secure connections. Replace leads if insulation or sheath is compromised. Record parts replaced and serial tags used.  
  - Perform calibration check using the reference thermometer or calibration bath. Compare readings at stable points representative of operating range. If drift exceeds allowable tolerance defined in plant calibration policy, replace or recalibrate the thermocouple assembly. Document outcomes in the calibration worksheet.  
  - The thermocouple calibration interval for Ring Rolling heat treat furnace #3 (EQ-P1-L2-HT03) is 95 days. Schedule next calibration in the maintenance management system and attach calibration certificate to the equipment file.

- Atmosphere and purge systems
  - Inspect purge line connections and flow indicators. Verify that purge delivery hardware is secure and free of leaks. Replace any suspect fittings and log replacements.  
  - Verify the furnace atmosphere monitoring system is reporting correctly and that sample points are unobstructed.

- Post-maintenance verification
  - Bring the furnace back to an operational ready state in accordance with SOP-P1-L2-01. Run a controlled heat cycle if permitted to verify that the controller reaches the austenitizing setpoint and holds stability. Log cycle data and attach waveform capture if available.  
  - Update maintenance records with a summary of work performed, parts replaced, calibration certificates, and recommended follow-up actions.

Acceptance criteria
- All mechanical defects identified are addressed or scheduled for corrective action; documentation includes photographic evidence and action plans.  
- Thermocouple calibration results are within the plant allowable tolerance or the thermocouple has been replaced and a certificate attached. The calibration date and next due date are entered into the maintenance management system consistent with the thermocouple calibration interval for Ring Rolling heat treat furnace #3 (EQ-P1-L2-HT03) is 95 days.  
- Control verification demonstrates stable control at the target process value. The austenitizing setpoint for Ring Rolling heat treat furnace #3 (EQ-P1-L2-HT03) is 855 °C; recorded cycle data must show controller reaching and holding this setpoint during verification.  
- No active safety interlocks are bypassed and all lockout-tagout steps are released following verification procedures in SOP-P1-L2-04.  
- Records to keep
  - Maintenance log entry including date, technician name, summary of work, and follow-up actions.  
  - Photograph attachments for door seals and refractory condition.  
  - Calibration certificate for the thermocouple and reference instrument.  
  - Controller data exports demonstrating attainment and control at the austenitizing setpoint.  
  - Copy of any purchase orders or parts replacement receipts and serial numbers tied to equipment file per SOP-P1-L2-05.

Notes and examples
- Example entry: maintenance record indicating thermocouple replaced, calibration certificate attached, next calibration scheduled per interval. Include the reason for replacement such as documented drift or physical damage.  
- Use the related SOPs for specific safety and isolation steps: SOP-P1-L2-01 for operational checks, SOP-P1-L2-04 for electrical procedures, and SOP-P1-L2-05 for records and traceability.
